profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer  Machine Learning & Generative AI  Robotics  Autonomous Systems Researcher
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at MathWorks, specializing in scalable cloud-native simulation infrastructure and Generative AI integration. I build intelligent tools that drive innovation in automotive and aerospace technologies — from autonomous cars to simulations with AI-assistance.
I bring a strong research background and hands-on experience in Machine Learning, robotics, and distributed systems.
I am passionate about solving problems that sit at the convergence of AI, automation, and real-world impact.

Core Competencies and Interests:
Robotics | Autonomous Driving | Deep Learning | Cloud Computing | Industrial Automation | Computer Vision | Research & Development 

Programming: MATLAB, Python, JavaScript, C, C++, HTML
Tools: Simulink, TensorFlow, PyTorch, LabView, Solidworks, AutoCAD, Autodesk Fusion 360, Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Co-developed and launched a Kubernetes backed Support Package enabling execution of millions of simulations with up to 1000 parallel runs. Achieved 70% reduction in memory usage by leveraging lightweight containers over full MATLAB instances
• Leading development of user-facing solutions for configuring, running and visualizing large-scale parallel Simulink simulations, via both CLI APIs and graphical UIs
• Researching the integration of Generative AI models to support intelligent visualization of simulation outputs and automate setup of parameter sweeps
• Built custom CI/CD pipeline with cross-functional team members, integrating MATLAB with Golang-based web services and disparate version control systems to streamline multi-language development
• Delivered support for combinatorial parameterized experiments; built backend in MATLAB with data modeling and implemented frontend UI using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS within the MATLAB environment
• Provide engineering solutions to internal teams in automated driving, robotics, optimization, and system identification domains
• Directly support customers in the automotive and aerospace sectors, resolving complex issues related to controls, massive simulations and distributed systems
• Collaborated across departments to produce and publish a marketing video showcasing automated driving systems
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Matlab · Simulink · Generative AI · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed autonomous boats for mapping, identification and treatment of invasive aquatic weeds
• Created a weed classification and GPS location extraction software for hydroacoustic images by incorporating Deep Learning
• Collected, processed and augmented hydroacoustic imagery for transfer learning on Alexnet
• Achieved 99% weed classification accuracy with MATLAB Deep Learning Toolbox using Nvidia CUDA GPU
• First-authored research paper, published in Applied Sciences (Vol. 9, Issue 12) and featured as the journal’s cover story

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for Design of Electromechanical Systems:
• Created application based interesting problem sums for assignments and exams; implemented them on web-based environment 'WebAssign' (Used SolidWorks and HTML)
• Helped students solve their doubts related to the subject or assignments

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
-Designed and built a high accuracy Oxygen Control System for storing highly reactive materials
-Used Arduino for real-time Oxygen tracking and controlling release of inert gas in the chambers 
-Used Autodesk Fusion 360 for designing and 3D-printing the control system.
-Achieved accuracy within 0.2% error and saved 30% inert gas compared to manual control

company.name: Center for Additive Manufacturing and Logistics (CAMAL, NCSU)

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
- Conducted parts and process audit for manufacturing and control systems at more than 25 suppliers
- Oversaw product life management processes for brakes and steering components including intelligent braking system 
- Actively engaged in preparation for ISO 9001: 2015 certification
- Successfully completed an offsite emergency, quarantine and repair project, leading a team of 10.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Completed project on Weld Shop Production Line Shifting
- Used AutoCAD for designing innovative jigs with new gripping technology
- Designed tasks sequence for minimum cycle time for robot in door hemming process

honors.title: First Prize
honors.description: Won first prize First prize in Hydranoid Rush, a hydraulic robotic event at Techfest-14, IIT Bombay

projects.title: Behavioral Cloning
projects.description:
-Built and trained a deep neural network to imitate human driving and successfully drive a car in a simulator.
-Used Keras on TensorFlow to build the network comprising convolutional, fully-connected, max-pooling and dropout layers
-Achieved high accuracy (>99%) by vigorous data collection and by using an algorithm to eliminate counterproductive data

projects.title: Control of Unmanned Automated Vehicle
projects.description:
-Developed the structure, circuits and algorithm (in MATLAB) for an intelligent, path following and object sensing vehicle.
-Used infrared and ultrasonic sensors, PID controller, gain scheduling and fail-safe algorithm for precise control and tracking

publications.title: Autonomous Robotics for Identification and Management of Invasive Aquatic Plant Species
Automated Miniature Universal Testing Machine (UTM)
publications.publisher: International Journal of Engineering Technology, Management and Applied Sciences · Dec 29, 2014
